# Code Kit AI — shared developer rules for ChatGPT, Codex and Claude Code

> This MIT-licensed fork of Warren Langeveldt's code-kit provides a shared Node.js rules engine and CLI for AI-assisted development. It keeps the original Claude Code hooks and workflow skills while adding documented ChatGPT/Codex onboarding, a portable CLI entry point, read-only diagnostics, a verification skill, a fail-closed Node-project starter, and regression tests. Agent instructions are not themselves an enforcement boundary.

Fork: https://github.com/whoami22888/code-kit-ai-dev-rules-
Upstream and original Claude Code plugin: https://github.com/warrendeanlangeveldt/code-kit
Requirements: Node.js 22 or later and git. The repository uses ES modules without new runtime dependencies.

## Source of truth and supported execution surfaces

- The downstream project rules configuration remains `.claude/code-kit.json` for all supported agents. Do not invent or duplicate a second policy schema.
- `AGENTS.md` gives ChatGPT and Codex repository engineering instructions; `.agents/skills/code-kit-verification/SKILL.md` provides a reusable verification procedure when available to the agent.
- `code-kit-ai` wraps the existing `code-kit` CLI and adds `doctor`. `check` and `verify` use the existing rules engine, not a forked implementation.
- `doctor` is read-only. It reports Node/git/AGENTS/config readiness. Missing or invalid `.claude/code-kit.json` fails the downstream-project diagnostics; without approved configuration the project is not governed by code-kit.
- Claude Code can enforce supported pre/post-tool actions through its installed hooks. ChatGPT and Codex do NOT automatically receive Claude's pre-tool interception. An AGENTS.md file or skill is guidance, not a sandbox, authorization hook, or substitute for CI.
- ChatGPT with connected GitHub access can inspect code, diffs, PRs and CI evidence; the CLI must run in a shell-enabled environment. Codex CLI/IDE/cloud can run the same Node CLI where git and Node are available.
- Always report actual results; a skipped, missing, stale or pending check is not a pass.

## ChatGPT and Codex quick start

Read the repository `AGENTS.md`, `docs/openai-integration.md` and, when available, `.agents/skills/code-kit-verification/SKILL.md`.

From this source repository:

```bash
node bin/code-kit-ai.mjs doctor --self --json
npm run test:openai
npm test
npx --yes prettier@3.9.10 --check .
```

In a downstream project with this package's `code-kit-ai` command available and an approved `.claude/code-kit.json` configuration:

```bash
code-kit-ai doctor --json
code-kit-ai check --json
code-kit-ai verify --base <verified-base-ref> --branch <actual-branch> --json
```

Resolve the real merge-base reference and branch name; do not assume `origin/main` exists. Inspect the `verify` JSON `skipped` records and require mandatory checks to set `ifMissing: "fail"`. Lane ownership is based on configured lane branch prefixes (or `lead/<story>`); an arbitrary `codex/*` branch does not automatically receive the same path-ownership enforcement.

For a Node downstream project, adapt `templates/openai/node-project.code-kit.json`. Its `node tests` check applies to `package.json`, `src/**`, and `test/**`, invokes `npm test`, and fails when the command is unavailable. Change the starter paths and commands to match the actual project before approving it.

## CI and merge evidence

- Source workflow: `.github/workflows/test.yml`. It is configured for pull requests and pushes to `main`, with Node.js 22 and 24 matrix jobs.
- Configured steps include `npm run agent:doctor:self`, Claude Code installation for compatibility tests, `npm test` (including the OpenAI regression suite), and pinned `npx --yes prettier@3.9.10 --check .`.
- GitHub Actions can be disabled by default on a fork. Check the fork's Actions tab and Settings > Actions if no runs appear. A workflow file existing in git does not prove it was enabled or executed; repository settings may require owner action.
- Validate the exact current PR-head SHA and real run URLs, jobs, exit statuses, required security checks and final-head AI review before merging. A green check described as `review skipped` does not prove a completed review.
- Diagnose the root cause of failing checks, repair minimally, add regressions for behavioral changes, and rerun invalidated gates. Never weaken tests, silently skip required work, or merge based solely on a static review.

## Existing Claude Code plugin and engineering capabilities

To install the original plugin in Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add warrendeanlangeveldt/code-kit
/plugin install code-kit@code-kit
/code-kit:next
```

Existing Claude Code hooks include edit-path ownership checks, shell command rules, layer checks, protected-path approval logging, spec and design gates, finish-time proof, and lifecycle/audit tracking for supported tool actions. Projects require their own approved `.claude/code-kit.json` to activate project rules.

The original code-kit workflow can progress from specs and architecture to lane assignments, parallel worktrees, requirements reviews and build status. These Claude-oriented workflow skills remain available:

- [next](skills/next/SKILL.md): select the next project step
- [spec-design](skills/spec-design/SKILL.md): brief, specs, architecture and implementation plan
- [init](skills/init/SKILL.md): derive and approve project rules
- [spec-check](skills/spec-check/SKILL.md): requirements traceability before implementation
- [dispatch](skills/dispatch/SKILL.md): lane-specific worktree delegation
- [review](skills/review/SKILL.md): review against requirements and merge conditions
- [status](skills/status/SKILL.md): progress and traceability
- [check](skills/check/SKILL.md): validate rules and ownership

Additional legacy templates: [CLAUDE.md section](templates/claude-md.md), [lane agent](templates/agent.md) and [CI verification](templates/github-workflow.yml).

## Companion and future capabilities

[Context Graph](https://github.com/warrendeanlangeveldt/context-graph) is the original upstream companion for file context, decisions and provenance. Its installation in Claude Code is optional:

```text
/plugin marketplace add warrendeanlangeveldt/context-graph
/plugin install context-graph@context-graph
```

OpenAI-native tool-approval adapters, provider-neutral hooks, stronger agent orchestration, SHA-keyed caches, a mobile-friendly dashboard and automated repair controllers are possible future improvements; they are not implemented by this repository's current ChatGPT/Codex compatibility layer.

Attribution: original code-kit by Warren Langeveldt; retain MIT licensing and original Claude Code documentation and functionality.
